pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You're asked to design a rate limiter — a system that enforces a rule like "no more than 100 API requests per user per minute." Walk through your design: what data you store, where you store it, how you check and update the limit on each incoming request, and how your design behaves when you need to handle millions of users simultaneously. What tradeoffs exist in your approach?
